'''Tregillis''' was an object<ref name="GG11">''[[Galaxy Guide 11: Criminal Organizations]]''</ref> situated in the [[Tregillis system/Legends|eponymous star system]], a part of the [[Tregillis sector/Legends|Tregillis sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[Trailing Sectors/Legends|Trailing Sectors]] portion of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="Region" /> Tregillis lay along the major [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace route]] [[Rimma Trade Route/Legends|Rimma Trade Route]] between the [[Wroona system/Legends|Wroona]] and [[Vandelhelm system/Legends|Vandelhelm systems]].<ref name="EA" />

At some point before the end of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a [[Unidentified Tregillis customs official|customs official]] was responsible for routinely inspecting incoming [[Freighter/Legends|cargo ships]] for contraband, but was also involved in an illegal scheme to steal goods from them. This person was exposed when he attempted to loot a cargo ship belonging to [[Cybot Galactica/Legends|Cybot Galactica]],<ref name="GG11" /> one of the [[Industrial Automaton/Legends|two]] largest [[Droid/Legends|droid]] manufacturers and a major force in the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Galactic economy|economy]].<ref name="CE">{{CSWECite|I|157|Cybot Galactica}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Tregillis was first mentioned in the [[1994]] sourcebook ''[[Galaxy Guide 11: Criminal Organizations]]'', published by [[West End Games]] for ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="GG11" /> Later, ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a reference book co-authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], placed the [[Tregillis system/Legends|Tregillis star system]] and the object itself in grid square M-15.<ref name="EA" />
